newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Death toll in Panama ship fire rises to four.
newsitem.headline: Death toll in Panama ship fire rises to four.

text.p: The death toll in a fire aboard a Panamanian registered ship at the outer anchorage of Bangladesh's Mongla port has risen to four, port officials said on Friday.
They said three Filipino and one Sri Lankan crew members died in the fire on Alexandra. Another Filipino, who was injured, was being treated in a Khulna hospital.
Port officials said on Thursday that one crew member was killed and four were injured in the fire.
The ship's local agents said the blaze started on Thursday after an explosion during welding on the ship. They said the vessel had reported engine trouble, but gave no further details.
It arrived in Bangladesh on Tuesday from Singapore, carrying jute, and was due to leave for Brazil after loading at Mongla, the agents said.
Port officials earlier gave the name of the vessel as Alexandria, which they said arrived on Thursday and was due to sail to Belgium.
Navy boats extinguished the blaze, the agents said.
"We are still awaiting a full report from the ship's captain. We have not been able to talk to him yet," a spokesman for the agents said.
